name: Waypoint, Patched
tagline: The flight console patched through: the Next up tube beside the route with a short lit lead into the row it reports, a vertical readout, and every list on its numeral law.
concept: This is Waypoint, Ruled with each hole the judges found filled by something real, and the 1969 instrument left whole. The Next up tube sits in Coming up's right column, and one short, straight phosphor patch lead joins it to the Next row it reports. One rule holds on every page: the filled jewel means Now or today, and Next is always the lit ring. Light runs only along the path from Now to Next; the rest is bone, steel and slate, calm and exact, and every hover is a steel afterglow.
companions:
- **Bone #d9d2bb:** every figure that counts.
- **Lead #b9b29c:** labels, the readout's dotted leaders (at 35%), the rule heads' bar and every pictogram. Vera's screen on the Settings card is now in lead too.
- **Route bone #c4c2b4:** the waypoint rings and the month chips' 2px bar.
- **Steel #6f8596, with cap #a9c4d8:** "here", every hover afterglow (rows, cards, links, starters, all moved off green), latched keys, the setup line's lamp and the tube's socket ring.
- **Sage #8fae86:** a new job, the tick on a Settings part that is set up.
- **Amber #e3a651:** only for late, as the triangle and the words, plus a half-strength amber scanline cell in the readout.
- **Kind tokens (clay, wheat, sage, steel-cyan, lilac, rose, mulberry):** 3px x 1.1em bars at 70%, with the kind words tinted to match, on Home's Lately added and the Ideas log.
- **#6dff9c is kept only for:** the mark, Send and the primary keys, 'plan.', focus, the live lamps (Today, NOW, Ready), the tubes, the Now-to-Next leg, the patch lead, the Next ring, the Now and today jewels, the phone's Next line, and one lamp per list (the newest Lately bar, the nearest drive figure).
decisions: Built in place on x14b-waypoint-cross. The palette tokens and the type scale are unchanged. The sheet was at 198,043 of the 200,000-character budget, so I stripped its long comments (about 20k) and kept the section headers. A 'Waypoint, Patched (revision)' block is appended with its own narrow-screen rules.

The jewel now means one thing (studio fix 2, made into a system rule). The filled jewel is only Now or today: a new jewel sits on the Now tick in both route SVGs (Home and the month strip), and today's date in the month grid is a jewel. Next is always the lit 1.5-1.75px ring with a phosphor numeral and a drop-shadow halo. This is done in CSS on the existing .stop.next markup, so Home's route reads the same as the month's.

Home hero: the annunciator stack now stretches from the eyebrow line to the starters' foot, its five rows flexing to fill, so the two columns share a top and a foot. The readout labels moved from Plex Mono to Plex Sans at --fs-label with 0.04em tracking. The head figures' units ('ideas / last added Sun 27 Sep', '4 open / 3 late') are now Plex Sans tabular too. Mono is kept for the machine's own words: the tubes, the model's name, an idea's number and the route's scale.

Phone Home: Today's date moved up beside 'Vera' in the eyebrow, with its breathing lamp and the date in phosphor mono. The starters are one nowrap row that scrolls, with a fade mask. A new lit Next line follows the box: 'Next', a 2.25rem light phosphor numeral, 'Oct/Sun' stacked, then the title, the time and how far off. The readout is one line of four figures (Plans 4 | To do 4 | Late 3 | Ideas 12). The next plan and all four figures now sit on the first screen.
Next up tube: 24rem by 13rem, with an 8rem radar. The glass is near black (3.5% phosphor tint, not 9%), so the bloom stays on the glyphs. The patch lead and both sockets are unchanged.

Ideas: 'Save a thought for later' moved below the log. The radar tube is cut to the rack's height (a 7rem radar, Nearest and Furthest only, the rings line dropped), so the log now starts at about y=470, not 650. The log is sorted nearest first by default, so the lit 18-min Pumpkin patch row leads it. A 'Nearest first / As added' order switch in the log's rule head is read in the template from ?sort=added; the server ignores the parameter.

Plans month: the 'Next · Sun 4 · Oaks Park roller rink · 13:00, in 2 days' readout sits on its own line above the strip, with a bare bone 22px numeral and no ring glyph. The strip now spans the grid's full width, so 28 Sep to 26 Oct spread across all of it.

To do: the rack spans the page width, with Search, Show and Whose on one row. Whose is now a latched segment like Show: Everyone first and latched by default, each name latched when its :target is active, counts as plain text with late in amber. The radio-like dots are gone. The head's '3 late' is Plex Sans tabular in --caution with a 38% caution underline.

Settings: 'Set up' is a sage tick, not a live green jewel, so the green lamps are off static configuration. Vera's screen on the Personality card is drawn in lead with no glow, like the other pictograms. Card hover is steel.
Status: the head figure's '1 needs a look' sub-line is gone. The Needs a look line under it is the only place it is said, as on Settings.

Form: the first rule head is 'What it is', with 'title and kind needed' in lead at the right. The rule-head link 'Back to ideas' is gone; the crumb stays. The 'Everything else' fold's summary is now a rule head of its own: chevron, head, groove rule and 'where, when, cost, links'. It still folds.
title: Send Vera anything to *plan.* The full stop is inside the lit run, set in Plex Sans Condensed 600: one line at 1265px, two on a phone. It says FamilyDB's job: everything goes through Vera (plans, ideas, reminders, wishes), and 'plan' is the word the route, the tube and the patch lead then answer.
measures:
- **Final full render:** 0 hard checks failed. One allowed guideline warning: page words, worst on Plans at 49.4% differing, inherited from the line's restructured month.
- **Contrast:** ink_on_bg 13.17, brand_on_bg 15.28.
- **Green share and hue entropy by page:**
  - Home: green 44.5% (from 56%, now under the brief's 45%), entropy 0.658, bright-green 4.46 per mille.
  - Ideas: green 51.1% (from 65%), entropy 0.587.
  - Chat: green 39.1%, entropy 0.636.
  - Status: green 19.8%, entropy 0.653.
- **Text and scroll:** smallest text 12px, no sideways scroll on any page.
- **Small targets:** none under 44px on Home, Ideas, Plans, Chat, Status, Settings and the form. There is one each on To do and the phone's Home, the same count as the parent on To do.
- **Colour separation (CIEDE2000):** kinds 13.8 typical, 6.1 deutan, 5.5 protan.
strengths: The light is wired to what it reports. One short straight lead joins the Next row to the tube; the Next ring, the leg and the Now jewel lie on the same path; and nothing off that path glows. Hovers, latched keys and Settings states moved to steel and sage.
One rule for the jewel on every page: filled is Now or today, the lit ring is Next. Home's route, the month strip, the month grid and the phone's Next line all agree.
The phone's first screen now shows the box, one row of starters, the next plan lit, and all four household figures.
Ideas reads as a flight log: the nearest place leads, lit, with real drive times as light figures and chevrons on true bearings. Its radar is the rack's height, and the first screen reaches the log.

Typesetting is tighter. The hero's two columns share a top and a foot, small labels and units are one quiet sans at one size and tracking, mono is kept for the machine's words, and both form sections have engraved rule heads.
Home's green share is under 45% while the tube, the lit word and the lead keep their full phosphor light. The kind bars and tinted kind words carry the colour the confetti squares used to.
weaknesses: Ideas is still at 51% green: the full-strength radar tube and the lit nearest figure carry most of it.
The Today row's date stays in phosphor mono on desktop, the one mono label left in the hero; it is the machine's clock, so I kept it.
The Next ring on the routes is lit by a drop-shadow, not the E21 blurred halo disc. It is crisper, but softer than the old jewel at a squint.
Settings section pages were not given new rule heads: their panels already have them. Only the new-idea form changed.
The Ideas order switch and the To do Whose segment are read in the template (?sort and :target), with no server-side support.
With five rows stretched to the hero's height, the readout rows are about 65px, not the brief's 52px; this suits the alignment but leaves more air between the figures.
revisions: Phone Home: Today folded into the eyebrow, the starters made one scrolling nowrap row, a lit Next line placed directly under the box, and the readout cut to one line of four figures (studio fix 1).

Plans: the filled jewel now means only Now or today (a new jewel on the strip's and Home's Now tick); Next is the lit ring everywhere. The readout is on its own line above the strip with a bare bone numeral, and the strip spans the grid's full width (fix 2).

Green share: the Next up tube is now 24rem by 13rem with an 8rem radar, and both tubes have near-black glass (fix 3). Every remaining green hover (links, cards, starters, rule-fig links, the idea cards) became steel. The kind words stay tinted. Home went from 56% to 44.5% green, Ideas from 65% to 51%.

Ideas: 'Save a thought' moved below the log; the radar fits the rack's height (7rem radar, Nearest and Furthest only, the rings line dropped); the log is sorted nearest first, with a 'Nearest first / As added' switch (fix 4).

To do: Whose became a latched segment with Everyone first and latched and plain counts, no dots. The head's late is Plex tabular in caution with a faint underline. The rack spans the page with all its controls on one row, rather than narrowing the rule head (fix 5).
Settings: 'Set up' is a sage tick, and Vera's screen pictogram is in lead with no glow. Status: the head's duplicate 'needs a look' sub-line is dropped (fix 6).

Form: the rule head is 'What it is' (I used this over the suggested 'Title and kind', because Description sits under it too). The rule-head link is gone and the crumb kept. 'Everything else' became a rule-head summary that still folds (fix 7).

Hero: the stack's top aligns with the eyebrow and its foot with the starters; its labels are Plex Sans at --fs-label with 0.04em tracking. All head-figure units also moved from mono to Plex Sans tabular (fix 8, extended into the system).

Declined: new rule heads on the Settings section pages, which already have engraved rule heads on every panel. I also kept the readout at five rows rather than adding a sixth 'Wishes' row; I stretched the rows instead.
Housekeeping: stripped the sheet's long comments to fit the 200k budget, and gave latch keys a 44px minimum width (the narrowed 'All' key had dropped under 44px).
crit: Home on the phone (home-phone.png): the first screen ends on the readout's 2x3 grid, so the next plan falls below the fold, which sank four lines in 14a. Below 40rem, move the Next row (or the tube at 9rem tall with no radar) directly under the starters, before `.readout.stack`. Collapse the stack into one line of four figures: Plans 4 · To do 4 · ▲3 · Ideas 12, with Today folded into the eyebrow beside 'Vera'. Also cut the starters to one scrolling nowrap row so 'Remind me to…' and 'We should try…' do not take a second 100px band.

Plans month (plans.png): the jewel means two things. In the strip the filled green jewel is Next (4); in the grid the filled jewel is today (2), with a lit outline ring on 4. The readout adds a third lit ring. Make one rule hold on both: the filled `--jewel` is only today/Now (put one on the strip's Now tick), and Next is always the lit 1.5px ring with E1 at half strength. In the strip, change Next's jewel to that ring, and drop the ring glyph from the 'Next · Sun 4' readout, leaving the bare numeral in --bone. Also stretch the strip to the grid's full width (it stops at about 775px of 1180). Put the readout on its own line above the strip, or as the strip's right label inside the width, so the ticks for 28 Sep to 26 Oct spread across the five grid rows' span.

Green share (Home 56%, Ideas 65%, both over the brief's 45%): the tube's glass fill and radar are the bulk. On Home, cut the Next up tube to about 24rem by 13rem with the radar at 8rem, and drop the green ground tint of the `.crt` glass toward near-black (bloom on the glyphs, not on the field). On Ideas, see the next note. Name the replacement as the lessons ask: the kind bars and kind words already carry wheat, sage, clay and steel-cyan, so let the Ideas log's kind words stay tinted. Do not drain them to --lead.

Ideas band (ideas.png): the log starts at y=650, so the first screen is all filters, a 'Save a thought' bar and a tall tube beside empty ground under the rack. Shrink the radar tube to the rack's height (about 200px: the radar at 7rem, Nearest and Furthest only, the 'rings 15 min · 45 min · 2 h' line dropped). Move 'Save a thought for later' below the log or into the head row as a secondary key, so 'Every idea' starts by about 440px. Sort the log nearest first, or add a 'By road' sort key, so the lit nearest row (Pumpkin patch, #7, now mid-list off-screen) leads the log and its one lamp is seen.

To do (todo.png): the Whose filter's dots (Alex and Sam filled, Household hollow) read as radio buttons, which the tour has already failed. Replace them with the square 'yours' mark or plain text with the count, and give Everyone the latched-key style of the Show segment. Set the head's '▲ 3 late' in Plex Sans tabular in --caution with a --caution-faint underline, not --code mono, to match the To do rows' late text. The rack stops at 843px beside 380px of black: either span it to the page width with Search, Show and Whose on one row, or set the Open rule head to the rack's width. Do one, not both.

Settings and Status, the green and the repeat: six green 'Set up' lamps on Settings cards (plus the Personality card's green presence glyphs) put live-lamp green on static configuration, off the Now-to-Next path. Make `.card .state.ok` a steel-cap square or --sage tick, and keep green for live lamps only. Show Vera's presence pictogram in --lead like the others. On Status, the head figure's '▲ 1 needs a look' repeats the Needs a look line right under it: drop the head's sub-line, as was done on Settings.

Form (form.png): the rule head reads 'The new idea' under the h1 'New idea', and its 'Back to ideas →' repeats the '← Ideas' crumb above. Name the head for its content ('Title and kind', with 'Everything else' as the second rule head replacing the details summary), and drop either the crumb or the rule-head link. Settings section pages should get the same rule-head treatment so the system holds on both forms.

Home, the hero's typesetting and alignment: the stack's top (Today row, about 145px) sits below the eyebrow's line and floats above the box with about 55px of hero ground beneath it. Align the stack's top edge to the eyebrow's cap height and its bottom to the starters' baseline (rows at 56px, or a sixth 'Wishes 0' row) so the two columns share a top and a foot. In the readout labels, set 'To do', 'Plans' and 'Ideas' in Plex Sans at --fs-label with 0.04em tracking instead of --code: the stack's mono labels are the only mono labels on Home outside the tube and the status foot.

firstDraft.name: Waypoint, Patched
firstDraft.concept: This is Waypoint, Ruled with each of its judged holes filled by something real, and the 1969 instrument left whole. The Next up tube moves into Coming up's empty right column at a larger size, and one short, straight phosphor patch lead runs from the Next row into a steel socket on the tube's case. That lead wires the light to the row it reports. Light runs only along the path from Now to Next. The rest of the page is bone, steel and slate, calm and exact.
